blocking_findings.requirement: Frozen C6 and R6, plus promise at prompt-drafting.md:7 that a fresh session need not possess this skill
blocking_findings.actual: All three standalone text blocks say to preserve history but do not prohibit treating copied/derived reports as independent support. Their lineage reference concerns review/budget continuity.
blocking_findings.consequence: A standalone prompt consumer may satisfy the printed contract yet count several summaries of one observation as corroboration or admit circularly re-derived support. Full-package rules prevent this, but are not carried into the promised portable blocks.
blocking_findings.smallest_next_observation: Add equivalent source-lineage semantics to template and both worked prompts, then inspect those exact blocks and rebuild/validate the portable export under 110000 bytes.
